# Dr. Harshika Wellness — LLMs.txt

> Dr. Harshika Wellness is an online homeopathic clinic run by Dr. Harshika Singh, BHMS, MD (Hom.), specialising in hormonal health and musculoskeletal conditions.

## About
Dr. Harshika Singh is a qualified homeopathic physician offering personalised online consultations across India. She specialises in:
- Hormonal & Thyroid Health: PCOS, thyroid disorders, hormonal imbalance, menstrual health
- Musculoskeletal Health: Arthritis, joint pain, back pain, osteoporosis, mobility concerns

## Services
- Online Consultation (video/phone)
- Case-based homeopathic prescription
- Follow-up and monitoring
- Health blog articles on hormonal and musculoskeletal wellness
